title: Storey Architecture hero
description: A full-bleed photo slideshow 110% of the window tall. Near the bottom-left sit thin progress bars (the current one wider and filling), a short white statement in a narrow column and a wide white button with a dashed ring. Slides crossfade while easing from 110% scale to 100%; on load the copy rises in; as you scroll away the photo sinks and dims.
notes: white text over media: in light themes it uses --background; dark: swaps it for --foreground
empty slides show a stone-grey (glow) placeholder with the original's top scrim and bottom gradient
the slideshow needs JavaScript (hydrate: load); without it the first slide shows
under reduced motion the slides don't advance by themselves
name: storeyarchitecture-hero
